data.title: bn-2gv: Give Lantern Leap a deluxe visual and animation pass

data.reason: LGTM. Variant normalization preserves collision and hazard semantics; new rendering remains deterministic under the existing dual-session regression. Verified cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings and cargo test -p console-agent --test lantern_leap. A 1,200-frame native sample remained well within budget (~0.93 ms/frame on this host).
